jobs.description: Would you like to be part of a public policy team that is shaping the environment for cloud computing and AI adoption across Asia-Pacific? Do you have the government affairs experience and policy expertise to independently lead our public policy agenda in one of AWS's most strategically important and complex markets? AWS is looking for a talented and seasoned policy leader to serve as Head of Public Policy, Malaysia. The Head of Public Policy, Malaysia will join a growing and dynamic team that works across Asia Pacific and Japan (APJ) in support of AWS's global cloud and digital businesses. Like our business interests, our policy issues are broad, forward-thinking, and driven by what is best for our customers. The AWS Global Public Policy team works with a wide range of national and supranational policymakers, industry organizations, and non-governmental organizations across policy issues spanning the digital economy — including cloud computing, AI, cybersecurity, data protection, digital trade, infrastructure investment, and sustainability. Reporting to the Director, Public Policy ASEAN & APJ Strategic Engagements, this role is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Key job responsibilities - Own and lead the full scope of AWS's public policy strategy in Malaysia end-to-end — from problem identification through strategy development to execution — with the goal of facilitating an enabling environment for cloud and AI adoption, protecting AWS's investment interests, and advancing strategic policy opportunities. Exercise independent judgment on high-stakes policy positions and engagement strategies. - Serve as AWS's single-threaded country policy leader, cultivating and maintaining minister-level and senior official relationships with key government agencies to drive alignment, unblock issues, and secure favorable policy outcomes. - Demonstrate strong political acumen and geopolitical awareness, with the ability to monitor and navigate Malaysia’s evolving political environment, anticipate emerging risks and opportunities to AWS’s policy and business priorities. - Anticipate and assess policy risks and opportunities with significant business impact (e.g., incentive programs, infrastructure deployment, market access), make recommendations to senior leadership, and drive mitigation strategies independently. - Create and drive policy programs that support business enablement, including public sector engagement to unlock government cloud adoption, advancing government partnerships and capacity-building initiatives, and enabling cloud and AI adoption in regulated sectors such as financial services. - Manage and coordinate external advocacy efforts, outreach programs, and key initiatives in concert with AWS business objectives. Drive strategic third-party engagement through industry coalitions, academia, and think tanks. - Facilitate high-level engagements between AWS executives and senior government officials, regulators, industry associations, and alliance partners to promote and advocate AWS's public policy positions. - Contribute to regional ASEAN and APJ strategic initiatives, ensuring Malaysia activities are integrated into broader regional policy strategy and sharing best practices across markets.

Manage inventory for machinist-specific consumables including cutting tools, inserts, coolants, resins, and filaments.
Support the physical assembly, wiring, and mechanical troubleshooting of robotic delivery vehicles and test fixtures.

Use computers for documentation, record-keeping, and tracking of calibration schedules.
Communicate effectively with the engineering team to prioritize high-urgency prototype requests.

Minimum 7+ years of experience in a high-precision machine shop, R&D lab, or prototype environment.
Mastery of 5-axis CNC programming and operation, CNC lathes, and manual machining equipment.
Proficiency in the use of precision measurement tools such as micrometers, calipers, bore gauges, and CMM.

Strong manual dexterity and hand-eye coordination required for precision assembly and tool operation.
Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds on a regular basis.

High visual acuity to read blueprints, measure accurately, and perform detailed craftsmanship.

Willingness to wear and work safely with required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) including eye and ear protection.

Advanced fabrication skills such as TIG/MIG welding or sheet metal fabrication.
Experience in the robotics, aerospace, or automotive industry working on autonomous systems.
Proficiency in electronics including reading schematics and performing basic soldering or wire harness fabrication.
Familiarity with Linux or Python for basic robotic system testing and troubleshooting.
